description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View called VoiceWakeSettings, which provides a user interface for configuring voice wake features on macOS. It includes UI components for enabling voice wake, managing trigger words, selecting microphones and languages, and testing voice wake detection. The file also manages microphone device discovery, locale support, live microphone level monitoring, and handling user interactions related to voice wake settings.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for configuring voice wake features, including options toggles, trigger words, microphone and locale selection, live microphone level monitoring, testing, and sound settings. Responsible for managing state, device discovery, and user interaction handling related to voice wake configuration.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: A data structure representing an audio input device with a unique identifier and name.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: A data structure representing an individual trigger word for voice wake detection, identified by a UUID.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the application's state into local trigger entry structures for editing.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Synchronizes local trigger entries back into the application's main state trigger words.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops the voice wake detection test, handling UI updates and timeout logic.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Discovers available microphone devices, optionally forcing reload, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the microphone name in the state based on the selected microphone ID.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a microphone device list refresh.

methods.name: loadLocalesIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads supported speech recognition locales if not already loaded.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a locale, including language and region.
